in_marathi.name: Bhupi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhupi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhupi is a Sanskrit name derived from Bhuhu, meaning 'Lord of the Earth'. This name is associated with the earth element, stability, and grounding energies.

in_bengali.name: Bhupi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhupi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhupi is a Sanskrit name derived from Bhuhu, meaning 'Lord of the Earth'. This name is associated with the earth element, stability, and grounding energies.
